reason: Coroflot publishes no API. The 'Design Jobs RSS' URL linked from the job pages (https://www.coroflot.com/design-jobs/rss) answered text/html on 2026-09-25 — the ordinary HTML job list (its own <meta name='url'> points at /design-jobs/rss), not an RSS document — even with 'Accept: application/rss+xml', and https://www.coroflot.com/design-jobs answers 403 to non-browser clients. No documented XML/JSON feed remains, so the runtime's XML parser has nothing to read. Missing: a machine-readable feed from Coroflot (HTML scraping is out of scope).
